extracted.intended_audience: patent/trademark classification specialists, patent drafters and examiners working with goods/service class lists (furniture & household goods)
extracted.subtask_description: A taxonomy/listing of goods in Classes 06 and 07 (furniture; household goods) used to classify products for patent/trademark filings. The page enumerates numbered subcategories (tables, storage furniture, mirrors, cooking appliances, tableware, cleaning equipment, etc.) with example items for each.

rubrics_metrics.name: 03) TABLES AND SIMILAR FURNITURE
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for tables and table-like furnishings: bedside tables, billiard tables, console tables, shop counters, desks (furniture), drawing tables, folding tables, laboratory tables, pedestal tables, school desks/tables, serving trolleys, trestle tables, work benches, table leaves/extension leaves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specific-purpose tables (tables for bridge, changing babies' napkins, games, the sick/bed-tables), household tables (bedside, dessert/rolling tables), trestle/folding/drawing/laboratory/school tables, consoles, counters (for shops), and associated variants (table leaves, extension leaves).

rubrics_metrics.name: 04) STORAGE FURNITURE
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for storage furniture and furniture with compartments: bathroom cabinets, bookcases, bookshelves, bottle racks for storage, cabinets (kitchen, medicine, glass, music, silver, stationery), card index cabinets, chests, closets, clothes racks, commodes, cupboards, file cabinets, furniture with compartments, glass cabinets, gun racks, kitchen cabinets, safes, shelves, sideboards, vitrine display cabinets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers both general storage items (shelves, cupboards, wardrobes, armoires) and specialized storage (racks for phonographic discs, bottle casiers for storage, safes, meat safes, pharmacy cabinets, cabinets for printed forms); includes furniture with drawers or compartments and wall-mounted units.

rubrics_metrics.name: 05) COMPOSITE FURNITURE
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for combined/composite furniture items: composite furniture, combined school desks with attached seats, combined furniture units, umbrella/ cane stands, wall-mounted storage cupboards, safe cabinets, wardrobes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes furniture combining multiple functions or integrated components, e.g., school desks combined with seats; umbrella and walking-stick racks; wall-mounted cabinets and combined storage/meuble units.

rubrics_metrics.name: 06) OTHER FURNITURE AND FURNITURE PARTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous furniture pieces and furniture parts: aquarium stands, baby fences, bag-racks for filling, bases for clocks, bed surrounds, bins, bookends, cashier booths, cask stands, castors (furniture), footrests, clothes/coat stands, confessional boxes, decorative edgings/moldings for furniture, drawers, dressing tables, easels, extension leaves, furniture legs/feet, lecterns, music stands, prayer stools, safety guards for babies (doorway/window), shoe stands with polishers, radiator covers, furniture doors, drawer parts and tips for furniture legs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all for furniture accessories, small furniture items, supports and parts (feet, legs, drawers, casters), safety devices for babies related to furniture, and specialized stands/supports for musical, decorative or practical uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: 071) MIRRORS AND FRAMES
rubrics_metrics.description: Mirrors and picture/frame related items: anti-theft mirrors, picture/mirror frames, mouldings for frames, mounts (paper), picture-frame rods/holders, wall mirrors, passe-partout, framing baguettes, photo-frames, mirror mounts and wall mirrors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes protective/anti-theft variants and framing components (mouldings, mounts), and items specifically for picture or mirror display and mounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: 08) CLOTHES HANGERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Clothes hanger types: clothes hangers with clips, coat hangers, skirt hangers with clips, trouser hangers with clips, stretchers (trouser stretchers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers hangers of various forms used to support garments, including specialized clip hangers and stretchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 09) MATTRESSES AND CUSHIONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Mattresses and seating/bed cushions: air mattresses (including vehicle and camping variants), bolsters, camping mattresses, cushions, electrically heated foot-warmers/heating pads, mattress covers/protective covers, pillows, toilet seat pads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes pneumatic/air mattresses, heated cushions/pads, mattress protectors and vehicle-specific mattress items; also foot-warmers and heating pads for bedding.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10) CURTAINS AND INDOOR BLINDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Curtains, indoor blinds and related accessories: indoor blinds, curtains, door curtains, pelmets, curtain tiebacks, valances, venetian blinds, embrasses and other hanging/ornamental curtain fittings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers both functional window coverings (venetian blinds) and decorative/window-dressing items (tiebacks, valances, pelmets, embrasses).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11) CARPETS, MATS AND RUGS
rubrics_metrics.description: Floor coverings and mats: carpets, doormats, bath-tub mats, bedside rugs, floor rugs, anti-slip mats for bathtubs, mats for automobiles, general floor coverings and mats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specialized mats (bathtub, automotive) and various sizes (bedside, doormat) as well as general area carpets and floor coverings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12) TAPESTRIES
rubrics_metrics.description: Tapestries (embroidered or woven) and similar decorative woven items; includes automotive mats/nattes and carpetettes where listed in this section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on decorative woven wall-hangings and textile decorative arts; page lists tapestry explicitly as 'embroidered or woven'.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13) BLANKETS AND OTHER COVERING MATERIALS, HOUSEHOLD LINEN AND NAPERY
rubrics_metrics.description: Bed and table linens and coverings: sleeping bags, bed sheets, bedspreads, blankets (including electric/heated), cloths, counterpanes, divan/sofa covers, mattress protective covers, table linen and napery, towels, pillowcases, quilts, eiderdowns, household linen, tablecloths, napkins, doilies, drapery, mattress protectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses bedding, table linens and protective covers for clothing/furniture, including specialized items for infants, hospital beds, and electrically heated blankets/pads.

rubrics_metrics.name: 99) MISCELLANEOUS (Class 06)
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous household/furniture-related items not assigned to other numbered subsections: blanket supports for raising bedclothes, Christmas tree stands, ladders, stands for Christmas trees, bed surrounds, protective cradles, footstools, pedicure footrests, plant stands, paravents (screens), shoe trees, valets, hinges/embouts for furniture feet, and a range of small accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all for assorted furniture/household items: supports, stands, safety barriers for babies, decorative borders, small ancillary furniture parts and accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 01) CHINA, GLASSWARE, DISHES AND OTHER ARTICLES OF A SIMILAR NATURE
rubrics_metrics.description: Tableware and serving articles: beakers, bonbonnieres, isothermic bottles, bowls (including finger bowls and bowls for washing fruit), buckets (ice), butter dishes, cheese boards/cloches, platters, painted porcelain (household), cocktail shakers, coffee services, coolers, cream jugs, cups, dishes (including warming dishes for infants/invalids), drinking glasses, eggcups, feeding bottles and teats for infants, flasks, fruit dishes, glass covers for butter/cheese, ice buckets, jars (lids for), jugs, plates, preserves jars, salad bowls, sauceboats, saucers, soup tureens, steins, tumblers, vacuum flasks, warming dishes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a wide range of household tableware and serving receptacles, specialized infant/invalid warming dishes, isothermic variants, and lids/covers for jars. Both functional and decorative household crockery/glassware are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 02) COOKING APPLIANCES, UTENSILS AND CONTAINERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Cooking equipment and kitchen appliances: alcohol burners for cooking, baby-bottle warmers, baking sheets, bottle warmers, bread toasters, broilers, casseroles, cauldrons, espresso/coffee machines (including for bars/restaurants), cookers (pressure), cookery molds, cooking pans, stoves (including camping), deep fryers, discs for preventing milk overboiling, dripping pans, electric grills, fryers, frying pans, handles for saucepans, immersion heaters, heating plates for stoves, kettles, kitchen stoves, ladles, lids for kitchen utensils, meat skewers, molds for cookery, ovens, percolators, poppers, pressure cookers, ranges (cooking), roasters, roaster grills, steam ovens, and associated accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers household, camping and some restaurant-grade cooking devices; includes both electric and non-electric appliances and accessories such as pan lifters, observation panels for stoves, and anti-overboiling devices. Coffee machines and espresso equipment are explicitly listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 03) TABLE KNIVES, FORKS AND SPOONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Cutlery and related table utensils: carving sets, forks, handles for tableware, table knives, oyster-opening knives/knives for oysters, salad servers and servers generally, spoons, handles for tableware/casseroles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both general cutlery and specialized implements (oyster openers, salad servers), and spare/replaceable parts such as handles for utensils.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 04) APPLIANCES AND UTENSILS FOR PREPARING FOOD OR DRINK
rubrics_metrics.description: Hand and electric food-preparation appliances: baskets for washing vegetables, beaters (electric or not), blocks (meat chopping), slicers, butter churns, cabbage shredders, chip/potato cutters, choppers (onion), chopping boards, mincing devices, colanders, cookie cutters, corers, crank machines for cutting meat, crushing machines for kitchen use, cutters (chip potato, cookie), cutting boards, manual fruit stoners, egg slicers, emulsifiers for cream (electric or not), extractors for fruit juice (electric or not), fish scalers, food masticators, freezers (ice-cream), juicers, lemon squeezers, grinders (coffee), kitchen grinders, ham/ meat hammers/tenderizers, mixers (kitchen), onion choppers, pastry cutters and shapes, peelers, poultry shears, rolling pins, salad/vegetable driers (spin-dryers), scalers, shredders (cabbage), sifters/sieves, slicers (bread, egg, vegetable), slicing machines (household), strainers, whisks, yogurt making appliances, presses for fruits/vegetables, and assorted kitchen hand tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encompasses a comprehensive range of household food and drink preparation devices (manual and electric), both small utensils and larger appliances, including cutters, graters, presses, mixers, and specialized pastry/confectionery tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 05) FLATIRONS AND WASHING, CLEANING AND DRYING EQUIPMENT
rubrics_metrics.description: Ironing and cleaning equipment: flatirons (including flex-holders), carpet beaters, washing/cleaning tools, ironing boards and covers, bowls, carpet beaters, cleaning appliances (for windows and vehicles), absorbent wipers, applicators for liquid wax, mops/dusters, clothes pegs/pins, rotary clothes driers, clothes horses, dusters, dustpans, drainers (plate racks), wash tubs, wringers (tubs with incorporated wringers), sponges, ironing tables/boards, sleeve-boards, clothes pegs and pins, washing tubs, washbowls, window cleaning appliances and scrapers, and associated accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both laundry/ironing apparatus and domestic cleaning implements, with both manual and powered variants (rotary clothes driers, rotating wash devices), and accessory items such as wringers, covers and holders for flatirons.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - 06) OTHER TABLE UTENSILS
rubrics_metrics.description: Small table utensils and accessories: anti-drip devices for bottle necks, anti-drip rings for bottles, bread baskets, bottle holders for the table, bottle stands for the table, bottle openers, bottle rings, coasters, condiment holders and dispensers, corkscrews (including easy-out), corn-ear holders, cozies (tea), crown-cap removers, cruets, clips for tablecloths, egg-toppers and egg-topping blades, holders for corn-on-the-cob, menu holders, napkin rings and holders, knife/fork/spoon rests, salt cellars, sandwich picks, sugar bowls, tea cozies, tongs, plate warmers, place mats, plate stands, and numerous small tableware accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers dining table accessories and small implements used during serving and eating; includes both functional devices (openers, holders) and decorative/practical accessories (coasters, menu holders, tablecloth clips).

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 07 - OTHER HOUSEHOLD RECEPTACLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Household receptacles and containers: ashpans, baskets (laundry/bread), bins (ash, bread), buckets (household/wooden/ice pails), canvas water carriers, chamber pots, coal scuttles, dustbins, garbage cans, iceboxes (portable), isothermic boxes (except packaging), laundry baskets, litter receptacles, pails, refuse receptacles, spice boxes, tubs, wash-basins, wastepaper baskets, water carriers and a variety of storage/transport containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a range of domestic containers for storage, waste, food preservation (isothermic boxes), and household chores; both portable and fixed variants are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: 081) FIREPLACE IMPLEMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Fireplace implements and accessories: andirons (chenets), bellows (fireplace bellows), fire irons (poker/tongs), pokers, fireplace screens, pince/ tongs for hearths, fireplace tools and guards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers implements for maintaining and protecting domestic fireplaces, including screens, pokers, tongs and bellows; includes household fireguards and related accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 99) MISCELLANEOUS (Class 07)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assorted household items not otherwise classified in Class 07: balls of wool and hand-operated winding appliances, non-electric bed warmers, boot jacks, hot-water bottles, brush holders, buttonhooks, can openers (electric or other), apparatus for drawing and filling bottles (hand-operated), foot warmers, funnels, gas igniters, holders for brushes and kitchen paper rolls, hosing and watering devices for plants, shoe trees and shoehorns, tube squeezers, stands or holders for tubes, camping heating stoves, warmers (non-electric), warming pans with handles, and other miscellaneous small household implements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all for small domestic implements and devices used in household maintenance, heating, kitchen chores, and other domestic tasks; includes both manual and electric variants where noted.
